summary: All rounding moved into meterbill/money.py (round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed); other modules call it, the context line is removed, and CLI output matched the original on samples plus extra tariff books/accounts/quotes; tests pass and tests/test_money.py was added. Kept as-is and differing from docs/rounding.md: cash rule 'whole' still rounds half to even (round(Decimal)), not half up; batch worker threads still round half even (context-dependent sites: band charges and effective price) while bill/quote round half up, via keyword-only `method` parameters.
